tokenomics.inflationGovernance: Max inflation cut from 5% to 2.5%/yr by nearcore 2.9.0 (protocol v81), activated Oct 30 2025 after >80% of block-producer stake upgraded (an Aug 2025 community vote reached 45% vs the 66.67% needed; validators then adopted the cut via the upgrade). Live config above confirms the current max rate. House of Stake is named as the venue for future economic-parameter changes.
tokenomics.impliedStakingAprNote: max inflation / staking ratio, before validator commission; assumes ~full uptime (realized issuance can be slightly lower)
tokenomics.feeBurnNote: NEAR burns transaction fees except the 30% of function-call gas rebated to the called contract, so burned NEAR is between 70% and 100% of fees; shown as 70% (lower bound). Source: nearblocks.io daily txn_fee. At current activity the burn is tiny versus issuance (see net supply change).

src: Blockchair /zcash/stats (free tier; its circulation field is broken/negative so it is NOT used for supply)
tokenomics.halvingNote: Next halving computed here from the consensus schedule (2,726,400 + 1,680,000 = 4,406,400) at the 75 s target block time; ZecStats reports the same block. ZIP 214 rev.3 notes funding-stream end heights move with the third halving if NU7 changes it, so treat the date as an estimate.
tokenomics.devFund: Block reward split (ZecStats live): miners 80%, Zcash Community Grants 8%, coinholder-controlled lockbox/fund 12%. ZIP 1015 (NU6, Nov 2024) created the deferred lockbox; NU6.1 (ZIP 1016 + ZIP 271, activation height 3,146,400, ~Nov 2025) disbursed the lockbox to a 2-of-3 key-holder multisig for coinholder-voted grants and extended the 12% stream and 8% ZCG stream to block 4,406,400 (3rd halving). Lockbox balance shown is the live value-pool balance.
